summary: ProConnect full-stack tested. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests passing (auth, categories, artisan flow, booking flow, role guards, 401/403/404). Frontend (mobile Expo web preview): onboarding role selection, auth (login mode), client home (categories + top artisans), category list with filter chips, artisan detail with date/slot pickers, booking modal confirm, and bookings tab all render and work. Google button present on auth screen (not interactively tested as instructed).
action_items: Optional: add testID to category list artisan cards so future tests can locate them by a stable selector group like 'list-artisan-{id}' instead of 'artisan-{id}' which collides naming-wise (currently functional but inconsistent with 'top-artisan-{id}' on home).

Optional: write Playwright coverage for artisan-side flow (register as artisan -> Mon profil -> subscribe). Not retested here because pytest already covers it end-to-end (artisan_profile_flow + subscribe + listing visibility).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single file (~400 lines) — acceptable for now but consider splitting into auth/artisans/bookings routers once it grows.
_id is consistently excluded via projection (good). Pydantic models validated. Roles checked (403 for client trying artisan endpoints).
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec; browsers may reject. Works for current usage but flag for prod.
Subscription is SIMULATED (POST /api/artisans/me/subscribe) — confirmed mocked per request.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed accounts (client.test@proconnect.fr, pro.test@proconnect.fr). Created TEST_booking via pytest which now appears in bookings tab. Seeded artisans (12) auto-created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL via EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. testIDs for category list cards are 'artisan-{id}' (not 'list-artisan-*'). Booking confirm modal uses testID 'confirm-booking-button' (not 'confirm-booking'). Slot testIDs are 'slot-HH:MM'. Date testIDs are 'date-YYYY-MM-DD'.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found. All requested backend endpoints respond correctly (200/400/401/403/404 as appropriate). Mobile UI renders cleanly at 375x667, French copy correct, touch targets adequate.
